meta.home_description: HoldMyTrack is a free, community-funded place to see every outdoor activity you have ever recorded on one map — Fog of War, heatmaps and routes from your watch, phone or old exports. No subscription, no ads, no data sales.
meta.site_description: HoldMyTrack is a free, community-funded place to see every outdoor activity you have ever recorded on one map — Fog of War, heatmaps and routes from your watch, phone or old exports.
meta.og_image_alt: A HoldMyTrack Fog of War map: the streets someone has walked cleared through the fog.
meta.title: {page} — HoldMyTrack
meta.help_description: How HoldMyTrack works: the map and its Normal, Fog of War and Heatmap modes, importing files, Google Takeout and the Android app, exporting a map image, and privacy settings.
meta.contacts_description: How to reach the HoldMyTrack project: email, code and issues.

settings.title: Settings
settings.onboarding_intro: Two things before your map: your country sets whether distances show in km or miles, and your timezone sets which day each activity falls on. You can change both here later.
settings.demo_notice: This is the shared demo account, so its settings can't be changed. Create your own account to save yours.
settings.avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
settings.name: Name
settings.country_hint: Decides whether distance, pace and elevation show in km/m or mi/ft, everywhere in the app.
settings.timezone_hint: Decides which calendar day an activity falls on everywhere in the app (the histogram, the activity graph, date filtering). Auto-detected from your browser when you signed up; change it here if you're somewhere else now.
settings.language_hint: The language of every page, the map and the emails we send you. Automatic follows your browser's language.
settings.private_hint: Circles on the map — home, work — that your tracks never show inside. Any part of an activity that starts or ends in one is hidden everywhere, including your own map.
profile.grid_subtext: Every day you moved, year by year. Only you can see this.
profile.trends_subtext: Distance over time — hover a bar for the full breakdown.
profile.trends_empty: Nothing recorded in this window yet.
admin.intro: Every account, newest first. Counts and distance are live activities only.
admin.times_note: Times below are in this account's timezone.
